source_definition_and_encoding: Willett FFQ Q3 past-year frequencies, pp2-4; portions listed itemwise. JAH3-10-e021245 Supplement Table S1 names AHEI components
equation_or_transformation: PINTIG Food6: calculate servings/day from nine source categories (never/<monthly=0, 1-3/month=2/(365.25/12), 1/week=1/7, 2-4/week=3/7, 5-6/week=5.5/7, 1/day=1, 2-3/day=2.5, 4-5/day=4.5, 6+=6). Sum listed foods by fruit, non-potato vegetables, whole-grain proxies, nuts/legumes, sweet drinks/juice, red/processed meat. Component 0..1: veg=min(veg/5,1); fruit=min(fruit/4,1); grain=min(grain/3,1); plant=min(plant,1); sweet=max(1−sweet,0) with 1/day adverse threshold; meat=max(1−meat/1.5,0). Final `100×sum(6 components)/6`.
missingness_validation_provenance_and_li: All implemented component foods required; missing=>null, no imputation. Food6 is a proposed simplified adaptation inspired by AHEI directions, not AHEI-2010/DASH/MDS: unavailable FFQ nutrient data omit sodium, fat, EPA/DHA and complete grain grams; fixed PINTIG serving factors are not validated equivalencies. Dataset score is synthetic and ranges25.7-88; Food6 is discrete and cannot establish equivalence.
